supabase/migrations/008_create_locations.description: Created locations table migration with organization relationship, unique slug constraint per org, helper functions for location lookups, and proper indexes

supabase/migrations/009_add_location_to_.description: Migration adds location_id FK to products table enabling location-scoped menus. Products with location_id=NULL are org-level (available at all locations). Includes trigger to ensure product/location org consistency.

supabase/migrations/010_migrate_existing.description: Data migration creates default 'main' location for each organization without locations. Idempotent design using INSERT...SELECT with NOT EXISTS. Products kept as org-level (location_id=NULL) for backward compatibility - they appear at all locations.

lib/db/locations.ts.description: Location database queries module with CRUD operations, slug validation, and soft delete support. Uses createServerSupabaseClient for server-side queries. Includes getLocationBySlug for URL routing, getDefaultLocation for single-location redirects, and isSlugAvailable for uniqueness checks.

lib/utils/slugify.ts.description: Slug generation and validation utilities module. Provides generateSlug(), validateSlug(), handleSlugCollision() for URL-safe slug creation with full Turkish character support. Use generateLocationSlug() or generateOrganizationSlug() as convenience aliases. Includes collision handling that appends -2, -3, etc. for duplicate slugs.

lib/services/index.ts.description: Services barrel export now includes location query functions from lib/db/locations and slug utilities from lib/utils/slugify. Users can import getLocationBySlug, createLocation, generateSlug, validateSlug, etc. directly from @/lib/services for location-scoped product filtering.

app/menu/[organization-slug]/[location-s.description: Location-specific menu page route handler. Uses two-level URL pattern /menu/{org-slug}/{loc-slug}. Fetches location with getLocationBySlug(), shows location badge with link to other locations. Menu items filtered by location_id matching OR null (org-level products). Contact info uses location-specific data with org fallback.

lib/services/qr-generator.ts.description: QR generator now supports multi-location URLs. Use locationSlug parameter in generateMenuUrl() and generateTableQRCode() for multi-location format /menu/{org}/{location}?table_id=... - backward compatible with legacy format when locationSlug is undefined. Includes extractLocationSlugFromUrl() and isMultiLocationUrl() utilities for URL parsing.

components/menu/LocationSelector.tsx.description: Reusable LocationSelector component for multi-location menu navigation. Supports 'full' mode (org pages with title/description) and 'compact' mode (location switching). Features: LocationCard sub-component, active location highlighting, address/phone display, empty state handling, table_id preservation. Import from @/components/menu/LocationSelector.
